reason: I already find local creators on Instagram myself and pay them with Venmo or a free meal, so I don't need a middleman. My creators mostly charge $100 to $300 or take free product, so a $500 Reel isn't my world, and Collabstr already does the marketplace thing anyway.
objection: Follower counts and results aren't verified, so I'd be paying a fee to trust the same self-reported numbers I can check myself by looking at someone's profile. And I don't see why this beats Collabstr.
would_change_my_mind: Verified follower and sales numbers pulled straight from Instagram, plus local creators in my city who take small deals ($100-$200) or free product, so it saves me the time of DMing people one by one.
